# e2b_snapshot (Resource)

Creates a persistent E2B snapshot from a sandbox. E2B does not expose snapshot deletion, so destroying this resource removes it from Terraform state but leaves the remote snapshot intact.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "e2b_snapshot" "checkpoint" {
  sandbox_id = "sbx_123"
  name       = "terraform-checkpoint"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sandbox_id` (String) Sandbox ID to snapshot.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Optional snapshot template name. If a snapshot template with this name already exists, E2B assigns a new build to the existing template.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Snapshot ID.
- `names` (List of String) Full snapshot names returned by E2B.
